items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I was with Don Redman... Don Redman and Benny Carter both. I was both of them before the War started.

ctx.x: At what stage did you go...? What happened then? What was the next stage after that?
Mmm, let me see. I'm trying to think of what... I was with Don Redman...
You were certainly with Don Redman. I think it was Don Redman before the War started.
